title: Sentences
summary: Sentences built from tiles, written down as they are heard and said, harder as they are known, then their gaps filled.
description: Words in use: whole sentences, recalled by building them and by ear.

requirements.text: A new sentence is shown on a card and then built from its words.
A sentence met before is asked by the card its familiarity and level give.

history.text: A sentence met before is either built from its words or written down as it is said, taking turns as it comes back.
history.reason: Building and dictation no longer take turns: the sentence's familiarity and the lesson's level choose among easier and harder sentence cards.

requirements.text: Where speaking cards are on, at most two known sentences in a lesson are said aloud instead.
A sentences lesson ends with fill-the-gaps cards over its own sentences.
A course's new sentences are cut into sentences lessons of `drill.sentences-max`.
